scripts.build: npm run build -w @topostack/core && npm run build -w @topostack/generator && npm run build -w @topostack/map-api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @topostack/core && npm run test -w @topostack/generator && npm run test -w @topostack/map-api
scripts.test:coverage: npm run coverage -w @topostack/core && npm run coverage -w @topostack/generator && npm run coverage -w @topostack/map-api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @topostack/core && npm run typecheck -w @topostack/generator && npm run typecheck -w @topostack/map-api
scripts.package:atomm: node scripts/validate-submission-env.mjs && npm run build -w @topostack/generator && node scripts/verify-atomm-dist.mjs && cd apps/generator/dist && zip -FSqr ../topostack-atomm.zip .
